design_rules: No random obstacle generator is used; every scene is explicitly numbered and hand-authored.
The benchmark world is 100 x 40 m with allowed flight altitude z in [0.5, 6.0] m.
Nominal start-to-goal distance is 96 m: start=(2,0,3), goal=(98,0,3).
Obstacles are distributed throughout the route rather than concentrated in one local patch.
Every scene blocks the direct start-goal segment and carries a known collision-free inspection route.
inspection_path is offline review metadata only and is never exposed to PPO, D.VA, EGO-Planner or SUPER.

MIGHTY.used_as_reference_for: ~105m end-to-end navigation and long-corridor dynamic obstacle placement; trefoil-style moving obstacles

SANDO.used_as_reference_for: 100x40m paper benchmark footprint and 105m route; trefoil motion semantics
